title: Spreading purely inseparable factors
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian integral domain with fraction field $K$, let $A'$ be a finite etale $A$-algebra [def-weil-etale-morphism] that is a domain with fraction field $K'$, and let $E$ be a finite $A'$-algebra that is a domain with fraction field $L$, where $L/K'$ is finite purely inseparable [def-pc-field-extension] [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. There is a nonzero $s\in A$ such that, with $A_1=A[1/s]$, $A'_1=A'\otimes_AA_1$, and $E_1=E\otimes_AA_1$, the induced morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(E_1)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A'_1)$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and radicial [def-weil-radicial-morphism], hence a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism].

source.place: proof, finite-algebra calculation, purely inseparable factors and universal-homeomorphism conclusion (Stacks Tags 00GQ, 0BR5, 01S2)

proof.text: The compatible fraction-field maps imply injectivity of A' → E. Identify the tensor-product map after inverting s with IsLocalization.Away.map. RingHom.localization_away_map_finite and IsLocalization.map_injective_of_injective give integrality and injectivity. RingHom.IsIntegral.comap_surjective (the lying-over node) and IsIntegralHom.SpecMap_iff give the surjectivity of the affine scheme morphism.

source.place: Lemma 00GQ (lying over), applied to the finite algebra

proof.text: Finiteness over the Noetherian ring A gives IsNoetherianRing A'. RingTheory.power_in_base_after_localization gives nonzero t in A' and both characteristic clauses. Since t is integral over A and is a non-zero-divisor in A', IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_dvd gives a nonzero s in A such that t divides its image. Thus t is a unit in A' ⊗[A] A[1/s]. Use tfae_universallyInjective, the field-point criterion of the radicial node. Two field-valued points agreeing on A' ⊗[A] A[1/s] extend via IsLocalization.Away.lift to E ⊗[A'] A'[1/t], and agree on A'[1/t] by localization extensionality. In characteristic zero, surjectivity of includeRight makes the extensions equal. In positive characteristic p, characteristic descends from K' to A' and then to the field of points; the power clause and injectivity of iterateFrobenius make the extensions equal. Localization extensionality gives equality of the original points.

source.place: Lemma 01S4 (radicial iff universally injective, via purely inseparable residue fields)

proof.text: The localized morphism is integral, surjective and universally injective, hence has an IsUniversalHomeomorphism instance. Apply AlgebraicGeometry.isUniversalHomeomorphism_le_universally_isHomeomorph (the recorded universal-homeomorphism criterion) to obtain the final conclusion.
